fork_status_and_schedule.highlight: Client release deadline is EOD tomorrow to prepare for Sepolia Shadow Fork
Releases confirmed: Teku (out), Lodestar (out), Reth (out), Besu (out), Nimbus (tomorrow), Prysm (tomorrow), Grandine (tomorrow)
After Sepolia fork, devnet-8 images will revert to latest trunk branches

testing_progress.highlight: Devnet-8 stable over weekend under three attack variants; most clients processing blocks within ~6 seconds
Security team found memory-explosion bug in ethrex on devnet-8; already fixed
200M gas limit assessed safe: Pavel's attack peaks at 2.5s execution; Jochem's slow blocks were compounded by debug tracing running simultaneously
Significant gap between Benchmarker (~2.5s worst case) and devnet (~5s) for JUMPDEST analysis on 100M gas block; cloud-attached disks and active debug tracing are suspected causes
Plan: disable debug tracing on devnet-8, then rerun Pavel's and Jochem's attacks; Besu requests trunk branch be used instead of release for this test

critical_infrastructure.highlight: EF bootnodes migrated from EthPandaOps to a new EF team; old nodes remain active until at least mainnet Glamsterdam, then deprecated
ELOC keys missing 0x prefix in JSON genesis file; Nethermind fails without it — PR open in eth-clients/mainnet for client approval

fast_confirmation_rule_fcr.highlight: Proposal: add a new 'confirmed' block tag (not repurpose 'safe') to enable FCR adoption; backwards-compat concerns from RPCs are blocking uptake
Chainlink went live with FCR today; other bridges and L2s want it; RPC providers blocked by needing to serve both safe and FCR simultaneously
Does not require a hard fork; consensus that FCR should be opt-in via compatible CL+EL pairs without changing default FCU behavior for all nodes

action_items.action: Disable debug tracing on devnet-8 and rerun JUMPDEST attacks (Pavel's and Jochem's) to isolate tracing overhead; use Besu trunk branch
Open async thread (EF R&D Discord or EF Magicians) on 'confirmed' block tag PR (execution-apis #908)

decisions.decision: 200M gas limit remains safe pending devnet retest without debug tracing; no repricing decisions until clean measurement obtained
FCR new block tag to be opt-in only; no change to default FCU behavior; CL+EL pairs that support it coordinate independently
New block tag name preferred: 'confirmed' (over 'fast' or 'fcr')

targets.target: EOD tomorrow — all client releases due for Sepolia Shadow Fork preparation
